primary_endpoints: max over root actions of determinization value minus public-belief value
public-belief regret of the determinization-chosen root action

inference.predictor_analysis: preregistered univariate Spearman correlations for numeric predictors and mean-bias contrasts for binary predictors

scientific_contract: admissibility and overflow sampling are frozen before exact policy values are computed
every source decision receives an explicit funnel outcome or remains outside the bounded hidden-Choice model
selection cannot use strategy-fusion value, chosen action, policy disagreement, or continuation values
both search methods consume the identical reconstructed hidden-world oracle for every admitted state
all exclusions and exact-evaluation failures are retained as evidence rather than silently dropped
a valid cohort with zero positive bias or zero policy disagreements is a successful falsification
exact reconstruction must reproduce the discovery-time hidden-item sample counts before policy evaluation
mechanics screening and exact search must reconstruct the same public statuses and side conditions
hidden worlds retain generator EV/IV spreads rather than a fixed stat spread

staged_claims.current: natural-state prevalence, value bias, corrected root-action regret, and structural associations under the bounded exact treatment
staged_claims.later: paired battle-outcome experiment using policy variants on identical battle seeds after the population study is frozen

non_claims: The bounded hidden-Choice cohort is not the full distribution of all Random Battle uncertainty.
The opponent response remains the latest observed fixed-damage move.
The exact continuation horizon remains one further player decision.
Material utility is not claimed to equal competitive win probability.
Structural associations are descriptive predictors, not causal effects.

superseded_cohort.invalidation_reason: exact adapter requires a known surviving opponent bench species or proof that the public bench is exhausted; one selected source lacked either structural witness

preregistration_amendment.reason: structural exact-reconstruction preflight omitted from initial admissibility
preregistration_amendment.trigger: index 5 failed before oracle construction because opponent bench was publicly unresolved
preregistration_amendment.rule: exclude any otherwise eligible fixture unless the public trace exposes a surviving opponent bench species or proves the public bench exhausted

superseded_cohort_after_forme_bug.invalidation_reason: exact treatment exposed generated cosmetic-forme worlds inconsistent with the publicly observed opponent forme; successful shard values were not inspected

preregistration_amendment_forme.reason: Random Battle getForme() samples public cosmetic/mostly-cosmetic formes before hidden set construction, consuming RNG
preregistration_amendment_forme.trigger: Zarude exact reconstruction collided because both Zarude and Zarude-Dada generator draws entered a public-Zarude belief
preregistration_amendment_forme.rule: condition generator samples on the exact publicly observed opponent forme before counting posterior support, mechanics screening, or exact-world construction

preregistration_amendment_lead.reason: discovery and mechanics screening condition Random Battle generation on opponent lead status, but exact reconstruction previously hard-coded isLead=false
preregistration_amendment_lead.rule: freeze opponent_is_lead from the candidate's public history and use it in exact hidden-world generation; use the same generator-species resolution as discovery

preregistration_amendment_public_state.reason: public opponent ability and already-Terastallized state were not fully represented in hidden-world reconstruction
rules: condition generator samples on a revealed opponent ability when present
exclude already-Terastallized opponents from this bounded study until exact type-state reconstruction is supported
